Carmen (Product): FYI team — tomorrow 07:00 PT were opening a limited GA preview for FlowBridge: a new hosted bundle that combines low-latency streaming + first-class tool-calling. This is opt-in for partners and select customers. Please review the preview guide before testing. :loudspeaker:
Ibrahim (Eng Runtime): FlowBridge exposes /v2/flowbridge (streaming + tool calls). It supports per-route fallback policies (model, region), and a new token-preserving retry for tool calls. No forced migration for existing routes.
Helena (DevEx): Quick try-it-out curl (use canary key):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/flowbridge \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_CANARY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"flowbridge-xl","input":"Draft a one-line release note","tools":[{"name":"http_get","args":{"url":"https://httpbin.org/get"}}]}'
```
Helena (DevEx): JS SDK streaming example:
```js
const stream = await client.responses.stream('flowbridge-xl', { input: 'Hello' });
stream.on('event', e => console.log(e));
```
Release-Bot: [release] flowbridge-canary started service=hosted-flowbridge region=us-east1 at 2026-04-02T07:00:00Z :sparkles:
Liam (SRE): Canary health checks: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms, 5xx < 0.3%. Canary will auto-scale to 2 replicas under burst. We created a dashboard and a synthetic monitor: please add your apps synthetic with the canary key.
Ops-Bot: Default per-route quota for preview orgs: 8 req/s steady, burst 40. If you need to validate higher throughput, request via #ops-requests with org id + expected qps.
Ibrahim (Eng Runtime): Note: tool-call payloads are validated against a stricter schema during preview; some legacy tool shapes may be rejected — tag me if that happens.
Carmen (Product): Internal Q&A tomorrow 08:00 PT (20m) for early testers. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/flowbridge-preview-qna. Drop any test failures or odd outputs in this thread or bring them to the meeting. :pray:
